b.sound: Bayobabs are often called upside down trees, because their bare branches look like roots.
Bayobabs are often called upside down trees, because their leaves are very fragile.

atoms.b: Fish River Canyon is located in the south of ((++Namibia Spain)). It is the second-largest canyon in the world, reaching up to 27 kilometres wide and 550 metres deep.
Fish River Canyon is also known for its 85-kilometre hiking trail. It takes roughly 5 days to complete and requires hikers to scramble over ((++boulders buildings)) and walk through deep sand.

The surrounding region is home to ((++desert tropical)) animals such as the gemsbok, which can survive for weeks without drinking water. Instead, it absorbs all the moisture it needs from the plants it eats.

atoms.a: Table Mountain is located in South Africa. It is 1,085 metres high and famous for its flat top.
Table Mountain’s cable cars attract 1 million visitors per year and take just 5 minutes to reach the summit.
Table Mountain is in the Cape Floral Region: an area home to incredible flowers that cannot be found anywhere else.
Table Mountain overlooks the city of Cape Town — one of South Africa’s three capital cities!

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Safari is a popular form of tourism that is very important for the economy across Southern Africa. On safari, tourists hope to see the iconic big five animals: lions, leopards, elephants, rhinos and buffalo.
However, safaris can disrupt the environment. Many of the vehicles produce lots of exhaust fumes, and the overcrowding of national parks can be destructive to habitats.

In recent years, more sustainable safaris have become increasingly popular. Countries such as Namibia have strict environmental protection laws that keep tours on official, marked roads and encourage guides to maintain distance from the wildlife.

hint.text: Sustainable means something that can be maintained for a long period of time without damaging the environment.
